clue.text: Great excitement about black flower

indicators.note: about means going around, so one piece is wrapped round the other here

parts.note: great excitement is euphoria
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A gardener is thrilled by a dark bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Euphorbias are the spurges, a genus of flowering plants including the poinsettia.

clue.text: What makes running of course pleasant and relaxed?

definitions.text: What makes running of course pleasant
definitions.meaning: in horse racing, ground described as ... makes the course pleasant to run on
relaxed describes a placid, unflustered temperament

explanation.surface: A question about what makes a racecourse jog comfortable and calm.
explanation.definitionFit: An easy-going person is placid and tolerant; easy going is also the soft racing condition of the turf.

clue.text: Girl taking in cities in France and America

parts.note: Pau is a city in south-west France
LA, Los Angeles, is a city in America

explanation.surface: A young woman visits towns on both sides of the Atlantic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cities' serves both countries: PAU in France and LA (Los Angeles) in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Paula is a feminine given name.

clue.text: Get very excited about section of contest

parts.note: over can mean about, as in a row over money
a heat is a preliminary round of a race or competition

explanation.surface: A competitor gets worked up about one round of a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: To overheat is, figuratively, to become too agitated or worked up.

clue.text: One of the fruits of battle

definitions.text: One of the fruits of battle

parts.words: One of the fruits of battle
parts.note: read as a variety of apple named after a famous battle, not the spoils of victory

explanation.surface: A reflection on what a military victory brings.
explanation.walkthrough: The Blenheim Orange is an English apple variety, and Blenheim (1704) a battle won by Marlborough.
explanation.definitionFit: An apple variety shares its name with Marlborough's great 1704 victory in Bavaria.

clue.text: Gathering in

definitions.meaning: a gathering here is a social reception held in someone's house
in means present in one's own house rather than out

explanation.surface: A harvest being brought indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: An at-home is a party given in one's house, and someone in is at home rather than out.

clue.text: Died leading brave retreat in county

indicators.note: leading means coming first, so this letter goes at the front

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for died, as in genealogies

indicators.note: to retreat is to go back, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: to brave a danger is to defy it

explanation.surface: A war report of a soldier killed while covering a courageous withdrawal in the shires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreat' turns DEFY into YFED. DYFED was a county in south-west Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Dyfed was an administrative county of Wales from 1974 to 1996.

clue.text: Used implement to reveal this little hollow

indicators.note: to reveal says the answer is uncovered inside the letters of these two words

explanation.surface: A tool was used to expose a small hollow.
explanation.definitionFit: A dimple is a small depression, as in a cheek or chin.

clue.text: Unusually soft and hairy shrub

indicators.note: unusually suggests the letters are set out in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A gardener describes an odd bush with downy leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Forsythia is a deciduous bush with bright yellow spring flowers.

clue.text: Bad spirit in heart of witness, appearing under protest

indicators.note: in a down clue, under means the letter is placed below, after the other piece

parts.note: a demo is a protest march

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its centre, so take the middle letter of witness

explanation.surface: An ill-tempered witness at a demonstration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heart of' takes N, the middle of WITNESS, and 'under' places it below DEMO.
explanation.definitionFit: A demon is an evil spirit or devil.

clue.text: Rest of old article by novelist

parts.note: Nevil Shute was an English novelist, author of A Town Like Alice
ye is an old form of the definite article the

explanation.surface: A literary note about the remainder of an old essay by an author.
explanation.definitionFit: Shut-eye is informal for sleep, a period of rest.

clue.text: Dull, low, continuous sound produced by instrument

parts.note: a hum is a low continuous sound
a drum is a percussion instrument

explanation.surface: A tedious droning noise made by a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: Humdrum means monotonous and dull.

clue.text: Plot that may be trendy?

parts.note: read as a plotted diagram showing a trend, not a fashionable scheme

explanation.surface: A question whether a story line could be fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: A plotted chart displays trends in data.

clue.text: Greeting Asian on top of the world?

parts.note: hi is an informal greeting
a Malayan is a person from Malaya in South-East Asia

explanation.surface: Saying hello to an Asian who is feeling elated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on top of the world' means elated in the surface but here means located high, in the Himalayas.
explanation.definitionFit: The Himalaya range holds Everest, the world's highest point.

clue.text: It's not becoming a grind, if possible

indicators.note: possible signals a possible arrangement of these letters, not the given one

explanation.surface: A remark that a dreary chore is unattractive if it can be avoided.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possible' rearranges A GRIND IF; 'if' is fodder, not a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Infra dig, short for Latin infra dignitatem, means beneath one's dignity, unseemly.

clue.text: Order member to gather in outlaw

parts.note: a friar is a member of a religious order
to tuck cloth is to gather it into a fold

explanation.surface: A monk is told to round up a fugitive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link here. Friar Tuck is a member of Robin Hood's outlaw band.
explanation.definitionFit: The jolly friar was one of Robin Hood's band of forest fugitives.

clue.text: In fluctuating temperatures, one appears elegant

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: C and H stand for cold and hot, and fluctuating gives cold, hot, cold
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone stays stylish whatever the weather does.
explanation.walkthrough: C (cold), H (hot), C (cold) swing back and forth; 'In' puts I inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic means stylish and fashionable.

clue.text: Charming female shortened garment

parts.note: cutty is Scots for cut short
a sark is a Scots word for a shirt or chemise

explanation.surface: A fetching woman in a skimpy outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: In Burns's Tam o' Shanter the witch Nannie wears a cutty sark, a short shift; 'Charming' means casting spells.
explanation.definitionFit: The name is given to Nannie, the spell-casting witch in Burns's poem, from her short shift.

clue.text: Moderate policy shown by television etc.

parts.note: via means by way of
television, radio and the press are the media

explanation.surface: A middle-of-the-road political line is broadcast on TV.
explanation.definitionFit: Via media is Latin for the middle way, a compromise course between extremes.

clue.text: It shows how much of the work remains to be finished

definitions.text: It shows how much of the work remains to be finished

parts.words: It shows how much of the work remains to be finished
parts.note: read the work as a book being read, with a marker at the reader's place

explanation.surface: A description of a progress chart for an unfinished project.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip placed between pages marks where a reader stopped, so the unread pages lie beyond it.

clue.text: Current supplier you're working with

definitions.meaning: the solver is filling in the crossword's pattern of squares

explanation.surface: An electricity company you deal with.
explanation.definitionFit: The national grid distributes electricity, and a crossword's squares are its grid.

clue.text: So much power in moving talk to WI

indicators.note: moving suggests the letters are shifted around into a new order

explanation.surface: An inspiring address to the Women's Institute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' rearranges TALK TO WI. The WI is the Women's Institute, a British women's organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: A kilowatt is a unit of power, a thousand watts.

clue.text: Avoid a new channel

definitions.meaning: to avoid something is to go round it
a new route built to carry traffic round a town, or a new channel for blood round a blocked artery

explanation.surface: An instruction to steer clear of a recently launched TV station.
explanation.definitionFit: To bypass is to go around; a bypass is a new road or vessel routing round an obstacle.

clue.text: Possibly provides an example of this sort of word

definitions.text: Possibly provides an example of this sort of word

parts.words: Possibly provides an example of this sort of word
parts.note: the first word of the clue is itself an instance of the word class being described

explanation.surface: A tentative remark about illustrating a type of word.
explanation.definitionFit: Possibly modifies a verb, the hallmark of this part of speech.

clue.text: Fatal result of backing modern forms of transport

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the whole run of pieces is read in reverse

parts.note: RY is the abbreviation for railway
a tram is a form of street transport

explanation.surface: A gloomy warning about the deadly consequences of supporting new vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reverses MOD + RY + TRAM as one run.
explanation.definitionFit: Martyrdom is death suffered for a cause, a killing outcome.

clue.text: Thought about a practice, doctor?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece goes round the other

parts.note: MD is Doctor of Medicine
use means custom or practice

explanation.surface: A question whether someone has considered a medical practice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thought' looks like a noun but is the past tense; 'about' is the container signal, not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Mused means pondered or reflected on.

clue.text: Girl in pool

definitions.meaning: A girl's name, a pet form of Katherine
a pool of money, as in card games

explanation.surface: A young woman in a swimming pool.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitty is a short form of Katherine and also a shared fund of money.

clue.text: Leading characters in this opera sing con amore

definitions.text: Leading characters in this opera sing con amore

indicators.note: leading characters are the first letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: In this opera the singers perform with love.
explanation.walkthrough: con amore is Italian for with love; Puccini's Tosca sings Vissi d'arte, 'I lived for art, I lived for love'.
explanation.definitionFit: Puccini's 1900 opera is named after its heroine, a singer.

clue.text: Garment of cloth unfashionable in normal circumstances

indicators.note: read as circum- stances, standing around, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: sane means mentally normal
out means no longer in fashion

explanation.surface: A garment made of fabric that would usually be dated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the cloth' means the clergy, so a garment of cloth is clerical dress.
explanation.definitionFit: A soutane is a cassock worn by Roman Catholic priests, the clergy being the cloth.

clue.text: Main casualty in Middle East?

parts.note: read main as the sea and casualty as one that has died, a lifeless body of water in that region

explanation.surface: A question about the chief victim of a Middle Eastern war.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dead Sea, too salty for fish, lies between Israel and Jordan.

clue.text: Noble somewhat deficient as composer

indicators.note: somewhat deficient says the word is a little short, missing its last letter

parts.note: a duke is a nobleman

explanation.surface: An aristocrat finds himself lacking as a writer of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somewhat deficient' drops the E from DUKE; 'as' is used as it stands.
explanation.definitionFit: Paul Dukas was the French composer of The Sorcerer's Apprentice.

clue.text: Honour in clubs, possibly, making a game of it

parts.note: clubs is one of the two black suits, along with spades
in card games the jack is one of the honours, the court cards

explanation.surface: A card player gets the jack of clubs and plays on.
explanation.walkthrough: The jack in a black suit is a black jack; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Blackjack is a card game also called pontoon or twenty-one.
